title: Cheating
description: Whoever cheats shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both. Cheating involves dishonestly inducing a person to deliver any property or consent to retain property.
remedy: File an FIR at the nearest police station or submit a complaint online through the state police portal.

title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
description: Any man who assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty, shall be punished with imprisonment of not less than one year but which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine.
remedy: Call 1091 (Women Helpline) or 112 (Emergency response) immediately. A complaint can be filed at any police station (Zero FIR).

title: Punishment for identity theft
description: Whoever, dishonestly or fraudulently, makes use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to rupees one lakh.
remedy: Register a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in and report to the respective platform for account blocking.

title: Punishment for cheating by personation by using computer resource
description: Whoever, by means of any communication device or computer resource cheats by personation, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to one lakh rupees.
remedy: Call 1930 Cyber Fraud Helpline immediately if financial loss occurred. File an official complaint on cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Consumer Rights Definition
description: Includes the right to be protected against marketing of goods hazardous to life and property, the right to be informed about quality/quantity, the right to be assured access to variety of goods at competitive prices, and the right to seek redressal against unfair trade practices.
remedy: File a complaint online through the National Consumer Helpline portal (daakhil.nic.in) or call 1915.

title: Time limit for payment of wages
description: Requires employers to pay wages within the stipulated time: daily wages at the end of the shift, weekly wages on the last working day of the week, and monthly wages by the 7th day of the succeeding month.
remedy: Submit a grievance through the Samadhan Portal (samadhan.labour.gov.in) or file a claim before the authority appointed under the Code.

act: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (POSH) Act, 2013
title: Complaint of sexual harassment
description: Any aggrieved woman may make, in writing, a complaint of sexual harassment at workplace to the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) or the Local Complaints Committee (LCC) within a period of three months from the date of incident.
remedy: Submit a written complaint to the company's ICC presiding officer. If no ICC exists, contact the District Local Complaints Committee (LCC) or file on SHe-Box (shebox.wcd.gov.in).

title: Security Deposit Rules
description: The security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall be decided by agreement and shall be capped at a maximum of two months' rent for residential premises and a maximum of six months' rent for non-residential premises.
remedy: Approach the Rent Authority appointed under the Act in your respective state to resolve disputes regarding withholding or non-refund of security deposit.
